reviews.author: Retash Mohan
reviews.text: Nice friendly family owned business! We were traveling from out of town and had to stop to fix a hole in the exhaust pipe. They took care of the issue quickly and at very reasonable price!

reviews.author: Tayton Johnson
reviews.text: I had originally gave them a 5 star for their service and cheap prices... however they mounted my muffler bracket to my transfer case causing tention and the transfer case to fail. I will never use dons again. They could have easily mounted the bracket the the frame and not caused any problems. Not I will be out 1-to-3k to fix it. Way to go. Luckily I stopped when I did or it could have destroyed my entire truck.

reviews.author: Trish Bland
reviews.text: BEAWARE I had a very bad experience with this repair/car dealership. I trusted them but now I know they are not someone to trust Tgey reset the dash so no sensors lights would pop up and when I got home all kind of problems started to happen. It's about money and not about the customer at all. I won't go in details. Go at your own risk

reviews.author: Robert Ritchey
reviews.text: We had a unique need as we had an LS Swapped Race Car that needed custom exhaust. Don's team did a fantastic job getting us the ground clearance and modularity we needed!! The pricing was very fair and based on a great value. Will go back, send friends and highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Dawn Seeley
reviews.text: I went in due to my exhaust making some noise. I had first gone to Meineke & got a $400 estimate...these guys charged under $150 & the car was purring when I left less than an hour later. I'm a recent transplant to SC so happy to find such a warm welcoming family run business. The owner & I talked about our kids & pets & she said for future work to give her a call if they cant do the job she'll tell me who I can go to the wont try to price gouge me. So happy I went for a second estimate!

reviews.author: SARA CULBERTSON
reviews.text: I have never delt with such kind people! I am not verse in cars at all and they took me back there to show me what was wrong with my car. And then offered me options at a super fair cost! I am so pleased to have found such an awesome place to get my cars worked on! Ill never go anywhere else again!

reviews.author: Katherine Ritch
reviews.text: Everyone here is amazing. They are honest about the mechanics of your vehicle and the prices are reasonable

reviews.author: Joey Rhodes
reviews.text: I had a 01 F150 they ran me a true dual exhaust and it sounds and looks amazing. Also very affordable and great service from the employees. I would recommend to check them out!

reviews.author: amber willis
reviews.text: Amazing place for all your automotive needs. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable. They are very fair in their prices compared to surrounding areas. They're also more then willing to work out concerns with anyone. I highly recommend them. Quality is all they know!

reviews.author: Nikki N
reviews.text: Have got three cars from this place. They are good people. Family ran as well. They work with you as long as you put effort in too. If you have any issues with your car, they try to help. Also if you need to have a car towed, they have a towing service. They fix on cars and get it done quickly.

reviews.author: Marvin Nelson
reviews.text: I just dropped my 2005 Cadillac off . But I have to say these people are very Good at getting the job done with your vehicle. They are good at finding the problem and getting fixed putting a amazing smile on your face and mine . I've had a problem with my 99 expiditon and it ran like a dream after these guy got through with it so I highly recommend them to anyone that has a major or minor problem with a car . They will keep your riding.

reviews.author: Isauro Bañuelos
reviews.text: They did a great job on my truck they put a pipe and tip in under 30 minutes. They work really fast worth every buck. They did a great job too. Good guys

reviews.author: Damian “Dee” Proper
reviews.text: Had my car towed there to have the idler pulley bolt drilled out because it snapped off. Great customer service and amazing work! I'd recommend them to anyone!

reviews.author: Franc
reviews.text: Not too keen with customer service, would make up lies when leaving me on hold. Like, “oh I couldn’t hear you” or when I redial “I was just going to pick up the phone”. For that I had to make a trip to see what was going on, soon as I walked in tells me “I was just going to call you”. Other than that, the mechanics are honest workers, will even show what the problem is with knowledgeable resolution of what they’ll do to fix it. I appreciate their work, thank you.

reviews.author: Joseph Hargraves
reviews.text: Staff was very friendly. Took my truck in with engine light flashing and they was able to get to it right away and diagnosed the problem and repaired it.am very pleased with the service and will recommend them when asked where to get a vehicle fixed.

reviews.author: Brandon Owensby
reviews.text: Went here because they said they could get it done the same day, had to argue with them once I got there to get them to do it. That was about a year ago and so far I’ve had 3 welds and a hanger break.

reviews.author: ERIC VALIANTE
reviews.text: Easy to find, park and leave the parking lot. Employees are cordial and professional, I rate the best in the area. If you need any exhaust work done go here first, you won't regret it.

reviews.author: Always Above Average Movers
reviews.text: Price is a little higher than the competitors when it comes to exhaust work, but you get what you pay for. Deff worth the difference to get what you want and get it done right.

reviews.author: Kim Richards
reviews.text: Real nice people. I love it that its family ran. They go out of there way to make sure everly thing right for you.

reviews.author: Kevin Bines
reviews.text: Went in to fix a wheel barring and they replaced the starter instead. Had to pay for that then go to another shop for the wheel barring

reviews.author: Patricia S Davis
reviews.text: We bought an older used truck from them for my daughter. Don always answered messages immediately, and he, his wife, and his daughter were friendly and helpful. A few weeks later, the truck had an issue he couldn't have foreseen, and even though he was under no obligation to do so (since we bought it as-is), he told us to bring it back for him to look at and then fixed it at no charge. I felt like Don was more concerned with taking care of us than just making a buck, which was refreshing and appreciated!
